blocks.zh: 前言、適用範圍、術語定義、一般要求與符號類別 5.1（製造商）
blocks.en: Introduction, Scope, Terms and Definitions, General Requirements and Symbol Category 5.1 (Manufacturer)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ISO 15223-1 的立法背景：語言障礙、全球市場與標準化圖形符號的驅動力
blocks.en: Understand the background to ISO 15223-1: language barriers, global markets and the drive for standardized graphical symbols

blocks.zh: 掌握六大核心術語定義（characteristic、description、label、labelling、symbol、title）
blocks.en: Master the definitions of the six core terms (characteristic, description, label, labelling, symbol, title)

blocks.zh: 熟悉第 4 條一般要求：風險管理驅動符號使用、ISO 7000 合規、日期格式（ISO 8601）
blocks.en: Become familiar with the Clause 4 general requirements: risk management-driven use of symbols, ISO 7000 compliance, date format (ISO 8601)

blocks.zh: 識別符號類別 5.1（製造商）的五個子條款：Manufacturer、Authorized Representative、Importer、Distributor、Date of Manufacture
blocks.en: Identify the five sub-clauses of symbol category 5.1 (Manufacturer): Manufacturer, Authorized Representative, Importer, Distributor, Date of Manufacture

blocks.zh: 連結 FDA 21 CFR Part 801 及 EU MDR 2017/745 對等標示義務，理解符號在 CDMO 充填製程中的實際應用
blocks.en: Link to the equivalent labelling obligations in FDA 21 CFR Part 801 and EU MDR 2017/745, and understand how the symbols are applied in practice in CDMO fill processes

blocks.zh: Foreword & Introduction — 前言與導論
blocks.en: Foreword & Introduction

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 為何需要標準化符號？
blocks.en: Commentary — Why Do We Need Standardized Symbols?

blocks.zh: 核心驅動力：語言障礙 vs. 全球市場
blocks.en: Core driver: language barriers vs. a global market

blocks.zh: ISO 15223-1 的根本問題很實際：一支預充式注射器（prefilled syringe）如果要在 60 個國家上市，標籤就需要 60 種語言版本嗎？
blocks.en: The basic problem behind ISO 15223-1 is a very practical one: if a prefilled syringe is to be marketed in 60 countries, do you need 60 language versions of the label?

blocks.zh: 這不僅成本驚人，還會造成設計混亂、物流複雜度爆炸。標準化圖形符號（graphical symbols）是唯一可行的解法——任何語言的使用者都看得懂一個通用圖示。
blocks.en: Not only is that prohibitively expensive, it also causes design confusion and an explosion in logistics complexity. Standardized graphical symbols are the only workable solution: a universal pictogram that users of any language can understand.

blocks.zh: 比喻：國際道路標誌的醫療器材版
blocks.en: Analogy: international road signs, for medical devices

blocks.zh: 就像全球通用的道路標誌（禁止進入的紅圈、停車標誌）——無論你在日本還是巴西開車，都看得懂。ISO 15223-1 要做的，就是為醫療器材標籤建立同樣的視覺語言系統。
blocks.en: Like the road signs used worldwide (the red circle for no entry, the stop sign), which you can understand whether you drive in Japan or Brazil, ISO 15223-1 sets out to build the same kind of visual language for medical device labels.

blocks.zh: 一個工廠圖示代表「製造商」，一個沙漏代表「有效期限」，全球通用，不需翻譯。
blocks.en: A factory pictogram means "manufacturer" and an hourglass means "use-by date"; they are understood worldwide and need no translation.

blocks.zh: 第三版（2016）主要更新亮點
blocks.en: Key updates in the third edition (2016)

blocks.zh: IVD 標籤特別規定：體外診斷器材（IVD）的製造商地址放置位置有專屬要求
blocks.en: Special IVD labelling provisions: in vitro diagnostic (IVD) devices have specific requirements for where the manufacturer's address is placed

blocks.zh: eIFU 電子說明書：新增 5.4.3 符號，代表「請參閱電子版說明書」，對應 EU MDR 的 eIFU 規定（EU 207/2012）
blocks.en: eIFU (electronic instructions for use): a new 5.4.3 symbol meaning "consult electronic instructions for use", corresponding to the eIFU provisions of the EU MDR (EU 207/2012)

blocks.zh: ISO 7000 日期更新：Table 1 每個符號新增「登錄日期」欄位，方便追溯符號版本
blocks.en: ISO 7000 registration dates: Table 1 adds a "registration date" column for each symbol, making symbol versions traceable

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務關聯
blocks.en: Relevance to CDMO practice

blocks.zh: 作為受託製造商（CDMO），你負責代客戶生產、充填和標籤。ISO 15223-1 符號的正確使用，是你在以下環節的責任：
blocks.en: As a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), you produce, fill and label on behalf of your clients. Correct use of ISO 15223-1 symbols is your responsibility in the following areas:

blocks.zh: 標籤審查（Label Review）：確認客戶提供的標籤設計符合 ISO 15223-1
blocks.en: Label review: confirm that the label design supplied by the client complies with ISO 15223-1

blocks.zh: 批次記錄（Batch Record）：產品標籤版本號必須對應當前有效的符號版本
blocks.en: Batch record: the product label version number must correspond to the currently valid version of the symbols

blocks.zh: 變更控制（Change Control）：ISO 15223-1 版本更新時，需評估現有標籤是否需同步修訂
blocks.en: Change control: when ISO 15223-1 is revised, assess whether existing labels need to be revised in step

blocks.zh: 標準版本對照
blocks.en: Comparison of standard editions

blocks.zh: 第一版（2000）→ 第二版（2012）→ 第三版（2016）→ 修訂版（2017-03）
blocks.en: First edition (2000) → second edition (2012) → third edition (2016) → amendment (2017-03)

blocks.zh: 目前有效版本：ISO 15223-1:2016，含 2017 年 3 月修訂（A.9 圖形更正）。
blocks.en: The version currently in force is ISO 15223-1:2016, including the March 2017 amendment (correction of the A.9 graphic).

blocks.zh: 注意：部分法規引用的是 2012 版，需確認客戶合約與法規要求所指向的版本。
blocks.en: Note: some regulations cite the 2012 edition, so confirm which version the client contract and regulatory requirements refer to.

blocks.zh: Clause 1 & 2 — Scope & Normative References Clause 1 & 2 — 適用範圍與規範性引用文件
blocks.en: Clause 1 & 2 — Scope & Normative References

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 範圍與規範性引用
blocks.en: Commentary — Scope and Normative References

blocks.zh: 適用範圍三層解讀
blocks.en: Three ways to read the scope

blocks.zh: 「識別要求」：本標準不只是符號圖庫，它同時定義了何時應使用符號的義務性要求
blocks.en: "Identification requirements": the standard is not just a symbol library; it also sets out mandatory requirements on when symbols are to be used

blocks.zh: 「廣泛醫療器材」：從注射器、導管、植入物，到 IVD 試劑、眼科器材，全部涵蓋在內
blocks.en: "A broad range of medical devices": from syringes, catheters and implants to IVD reagents and ophthalmic devices, all are covered

blocks.zh: 「不適用於其他標準規定的符號」：例如 EN 60601 系列（電氣安全）有自己的符號體系，不混用
blocks.en: "Not applicable to symbols specified in other standards": for example, the EN 60601 series (electrical safety) has its own symbol system, and the two are not mixed

blocks.zh: 四個規範性引用標準詳解
blocks.en: The four normative references in detail

blocks.zh: ISO 7000 — 符號的「身份證字號」來源。ISO 15223-1 Table 1 中每個符號都標有 ISO 7000 的登錄號碼（如 ISO 7000-3082 代表製造商符號）。這個號碼讓你能追溯圖形的官方版本。
blocks.en: ISO 7000 — the source of each symbol's "ID number". Every symbol in ISO 15223-1 Table 1 carries its ISO 7000 registration number (for example, ISO 7000-3082 is the manufacturer symbol). This number lets you trace the official version of the graphic.

blocks.zh: IEC 80416-1 — 定義什麼叫做 "title"、"description"、"characteristic information"（下一條款的術語都源自此標準）。
blocks.en: IEC 80416-1 — defines what is meant by "title", "description" and "characteristic information" (the terms in the next clause all originate from this standard).

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 — 風險管理是符號使用的觸發條件。不是所有資訊都必須用符號，而是當風險評估顯示「有必要」時才使用。
blocks.en: ISO 14971 — risk management is the trigger for using symbols. Not all information has to be conveyed with symbols; they are used only when the risk assessment shows it is "appropriate".

blocks.zh: ISO 8601 — 日期格式標準化。製造日期、有效期限，必須用 YYYY-MM-DD 格式，而非各國習慣的 DD/MM/YYYY 或 MM/DD/YYYY。
blocks.en: ISO 8601 — standardizes date format. The date of manufacture and the use-by date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format, not the DD/MM/YYYY or MM/DD/YYYY customary in individual countries.

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR Part 801 對應
blocks.en: Correspondence with FDA 21 CFR Part 801

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR Part 801 要求醫療器材標籤必須包含足夠資訊供安全使用。雖然 FDA 不強制要求使用 ISO 15223-1 符號，但 FDA 於 2016 年發布指引 "Use of International Standard ISO 10993-1"，並在標籤指引中認可使用 ISO 15223-1 符號，條件是：
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR Part 801 requires medical device labels to carry enough information for safe use. Although FDA does not mandate the use of ISO 15223-1 symbols, in 2016 it issued the guidance "Use of International Standard ISO 10993-1" and, in its labelling guidance, recognizes the use of ISO 15223-1 symbols provided that:

blocks.zh: 符號旁邊有英文說明文字（伴隨文字），或
blocks.en: the symbol is accompanied by explanatory English text (accompanying text), or

blocks.zh: 製造商能提供符號含義的書面說明給最終使用者
blocks.en: the manufacturer can provide the end user with a written explanation of the symbol's meaning

blocks.zh: 實務上：在美國市場銷售的器材，建議在符號旁保留英文 title（如 "Manufacturer"），以符合 FDA 的理解性要求。
blocks.en: In practice: for devices sold in the US market, it is advisable to keep the English title (such as "Manufacturer") next to the symbol to meet FDA's comprehension requirements.

blocks.zh: EU MDR 2017/745 對應
blocks.en: Correspondence with EU MDR 2017/745

blocks.zh: EU MDR Annex I（基本安全和性能要求）第 23 條規定標籤必須清晰可讀，Annex I 第 23.2(d) 明確允許使用符號。EU MDR 2017/745 直接引用 ISO 15223-1 作為符合性標準（harmonized standard）。
blocks.en: EU MDR Annex I (General Safety and Performance Requirements), section 23, requires labels to be clearly legible, and Annex I, 23.2(d), expressly permits the use of symbols. EU MDR 2017/745 refers directly to ISO 15223-1 as a harmonized standard for demonstrating conformity.

blocks.zh: 這意味著在歐盟市場上正確使用 ISO 15223-1 符號，可作為符合 EU MDR 標籤要求的技術文件依據。
blocks.en: This means that using ISO 15223-1 symbols correctly in the EU market can serve as a technical documentation basis for compliance with the EU MDR labelling requirements.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Discussion exercises

blocks.zh: 你的客戶要求在一個胰島素預充注射器上只用符號（不加文字）標示製造日期。ISO 15223-1 第 4.2 條允許這樣做嗎？FDA 呢？EU MDR 呢？
blocks.en: Your client wants to indicate the date of manufacture on an insulin prefilled syringe using only a symbol (no text). Does ISO 15223-1 Clause 4.2 allow this? What about FDA? And the EU MDR?

blocks.zh: 如果一個符號在 ISO 7000 有登錄，但未被 ISO 15223-1 Table 1 收錄，你的客戶可以直接使用它嗎？
blocks.en: If a symbol is registered in ISO 7000 but not included in ISO 15223-1 Table 1, can your client use it directly?

blocks.zh: ISO 8601 格式的「2026年4月9日」應如何書寫在標籤上？
blocks.en: How should "9 April 2026" be written on a label in ISO 8601 format?

blocks.zh: Clause 3 — Terms & Definitions Clause 3 — 術語與定義
blocks.en: Clause 3 — Terms & Definitions

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 六大術語詳解
blocks.en: Commentary — The Six Terms Explained

blocks.zh: 3.1 Characteristic Information（特性資訊）
blocks.en: 3.1 Characteristic Information

blocks.zh: 這是符號所傳遞的「訊息本質」。例如工廠圖示（製造商符號）的 characteristic information 就是「這是製造這個器材的實體」。
blocks.en: This is the "essence of the message" that a symbol conveys. For example, the characteristic information of the factory pictogram (the manufacturer symbol) is "this is the entity that made this device".

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：在你的標籤審查 SOP 中，審查人員需要確認每個符號所傳遞的 characteristic information 與產品實際情況一致（例如確認工廠圖示旁的公司名稱確實是 MAH 而非 CMO）。
blocks.en: CDMO application: in your label review SOP, reviewers need to confirm that the characteristic information conveyed by each symbol is consistent with the actual product situation (for example, confirm that the company name next to the factory pictogram really is the MAH and not the CMO).

blocks.zh: 3.2 Description（描述）vs. 3.6 Title（標題）
blocks.en: 3.2 Description vs. 3.6 Title

blocks.zh: Title = 符號的「名字」，用於識別和引用。例如：「Manufacturer」是 5.1.1 符號的 title。
blocks.en: Title = the symbol's "name", used for identification and reference. For example, "Manufacturer" is the title of the 5.1.1 symbol.

blocks.zh: Description = 符號的「規範性文字」，定義用途、適用情境和使用方式。這是 Table 1 中最重要的欄位，因為它具有規範性（normative）效力。
blocks.en: Description = the symbol's "normative text", which defines its purpose, applicable situations and manner of use. This is the most important column in Table 1 because it carries normative force.

blocks.zh: 區別重要性：當法規或合約引用 ISO 15223-1 符號時，你必須遵守 description，而不只是「形狀看起來像就好」。
blocks.en: Why the distinction matters: when a regulation or contract refers to an ISO 15223-1 symbol, you must comply with the description, not merely produce something that "looks about right".

blocks.zh: 3.3 Label（標籤）vs. 3.4 Labelling（標示）
blocks.en: 3.3 Label vs. 3.4 Labelling

blocks.zh: Label（標籤）= 直接貼在產品本體上的實體標籤。例如貼在玻璃瓶身上的紙質標籤。
blocks.en: Label = the physical label attached directly to the product itself, for example the paper label on a glass vial.

blocks.zh: Labelling（標示）= 更廣義的概念，包含標籤、包裝上的印刷資訊、說明書（IFU）、甚至產品網站上的資訊。排除：出貨文件（shipping documents）。
blocks.en: Labelling = a broader concept that includes the label, information printed on the packaging, the instructions for use (IFU) and even information on the product website. Excluded: shipping documents.

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR Part 801 的 "labeling"（注意美式拼法只有一個 l）對應 ISO 的 "labelling"，兩者定義非常接近。
blocks.en: The term "labeling" in FDA 21 CFR Part 801 (note the American spelling with a single l) corresponds to "labelling" in ISO; the two definitions are very close.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Label vs. Labelling
blocks.en: Analogy: Label vs. Labelling

blocks.zh: 把一個預充式注射器想像成一本書：
blocks.en: Imagine a prefilled syringe as a book:

blocks.zh: Label = 書的封面（直接貼在產品上的那張貼紙）
blocks.en: Label = the book's front cover (the sticker attached directly to the product)

blocks.zh: Labelling = 整個出版資訊系統（封面 + 封底 + 版權頁 + 附冊說明書），但不含書商的送貨單
blocks.en: Labelling = the whole publishing information system (front cover + back cover + copyright page + accompanying booklet), but not the bookseller's delivery note

blocks.zh: 3.5 Symbol（符號）— 最核心的定義
blocks.en: 3.5 Symbol — the most central definition

blocks.zh: 關鍵詞："without the need for... knowledge of the language"——這就是符號存在的根本理由。符號必須跨越語言障礙，做到真正的視覺溝通。
blocks.en: Key phrase: "without the need for... knowledge of the language". This is the fundamental reason symbols exist. A symbol must cross the language barrier and achieve genuine visual communication.

blocks.zh: Note 1 很重要：符號可以是抽象圖形（如波浪代表非滅菌），也可以是熟悉物件（如工廠建築代表製造商），甚至可以包含英數字符（如"2°C–8°C"配合雪花圖示）。
blocks.en: Note 1 is important: a symbol can be an abstract graphic (such as a wavy line for non-sterile), a familiar object (such as a factory building for manufacturer), or even contain alphanumeric characters (such as "2°C–8°C" together with a snowflake pictogram).

blocks.zh: 術語應用練習
blocks.en: Practice exercises on the terms

blocks.zh: 一份充填製造廠的 SOP 寫道：「標籤上必須印有製造商名稱」。這裡的「標籤」是 3.3 label 還是 3.4 labelling 的範疇？
blocks.en: A filling site's SOP states: "The label must bear the manufacturer's name." Does "label" here fall under 3.3 label or 3.4 labelling?

blocks.zh: 一個產品說明書（IFU）上印有 ISO 15223-1 符號。這屬於 label 還是 labelling？
blocks.en: A product instruction leaflet (IFU) carries ISO 15223-1 symbols. Is this a label or labelling?

blocks.zh: Title 和 Description 都在 Table 1 中——如果兩者有細微衝突，以哪個為準？（提示：想想 normative vs. informative 的概念）
blocks.en: Title and Description both appear in Table 1. If the two conflict slightly, which prevails? (Hint: think about normative vs. informative.)

blocks.zh: Clause 4 — General Requirements Clause 4 — 一般要求
blocks.en: Clause 4 — General Requirements

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 一般要求五大核心
blocks.en: Commentary — The Five Core General Requirements

blocks.zh: 核心一：風險管理驅動符號使用（4.2）
blocks.en: Core 1: risk management drives the use of symbols (4.2)

blocks.zh: 關鍵句："When risk management shows it to be appropriate..."
blocks.en: Key sentence: "When risk management shows it to be appropriate..."

blocks.zh: 這意味著符號不是強制貼滿標籤的裝飾，而是風險管理（ISO 14971）的輸出結果。你的 Risk Management File 應記錄：
blocks.en: This means symbols are not decoration to be plastered all over the label, but an output of risk management (ISO 14971). Your Risk Management File should record:

blocks.zh: 哪些資訊對安全使用至關重要
blocks.en: which information is critical to safe use

blocks.zh: 為什麼選擇使用符號（而非純文字）來傳遞這些資訊
blocks.en: why symbols (rather than plain text) were chosen to convey this information

blocks.zh: 符號使用是否可能引入新風險（例如使用者誤解）
blocks.en: whether the use of a symbol could introduce new risks (for example, misinterpretation by users)

blocks.zh: 核心二：ISO 7000 圖形合規性
blocks.en: Core 2: ISO 7000 graphic compliance

blocks.zh: 不能「看起來像」就好——ISO 7000 登錄符號有嚴格的圖形規格要求：
blocks.en: "Looks similar" is not good enough: symbols registered in ISO 7000 have strict graphic specifications:

blocks.zh: 相對尺寸比例：工廠圖示的屋頂高度、煙囪寬度都有規定比例
blocks.en: Relative proportions: the roof height and chimney width of the factory pictogram follow prescribed proportions

blocks.zh: 線條粗細：細線和粗線的相對比例需一致
blocks.en: Line weight: the relative proportion of thin and thick lines must be consistent

blocks.zh: 方向（Orientation）：符號不能隨意旋轉（某些符號有方向性意義）
blocks.en: Orientation: symbols may not be rotated at will (for some symbols, orientation carries meaning)

blocks.zh: 填色 / 陰影：有些符號要求實心，有些要求空心，不能互換
blocks.en: Fill / shading: some symbols must be solid and others outlined, and the two cannot be interchanged

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：你的美工設計師在重繪符號時，必須參照 ISO OBP 線上資料庫的官方圖形（可下載 AI、DWG、EPS 格式），不能自行「美化」或縮放比例。
blocks.en: CDMO practice: when your graphic designer redraws a symbol, they must work from the official graphics in the ISO Online Browsing Platform (OBP) database (downloadable in AI, DWG and EPS formats) and must not "improve" the symbol or alter its proportions.

blocks.zh: 核心三：使用前必須做風險評估
blocks.en: Core 3: a risk assessment is required before use

blocks.zh: 這是 shall（強制性）要求。你需要在技術文件（Technical File / Design History File）中留下使用者理解性測試（usability testing）或等效評估記錄，證明目標使用者群體能正確理解每個符號。
blocks.en: This is a shall (mandatory) requirement. In the technical documentation (Technical File / Design History File), you need to keep records of usability testing, or an equivalent assessment, showing that the intended user group can correctly understand each symbol.

blocks.zh: 核心四：伴隨文字（Accompanying Text）
blocks.en: Core 4: accompanying text

blocks.zh: 符號可以單獨使用（不加文字），但有條件：
blocks.en: A symbol may be used on its own (without text), subject to conditions:

blocks.zh: 如法規要求伴隨文字（如 FDA 對美國市場的要求），則應加上符號的 title
blocks.en: If a regulation requires accompanying text (for example, FDA's requirement for the US market), the symbol's title should be added

blocks.zh: Title（如"Manufacturer"）被視為「足夠」的伴隨文字
blocks.en: The title (such as "Manufacturer") is regarded as "sufficient" accompanying text

blocks.zh: 不需要加完整的 description 文字
blocks.en: There is no need to add the full description text

blocks.zh: EU MDR Annex I 第 23.4(ab) 允許使用符號，但需確保在使用者群體中能被正確理解。
blocks.en: EU MDR Annex I, 23.4(ab), permits the use of symbols, but it must be ensured that they can be correctly understood within the user group.

blocks.zh: 4.3 其他符號 — 重要排除條款
blocks.en: 4.3 Other symbols — an important exclusion clause

blocks.zh: ISO 15223-1 不是唯一的醫療器材符號標準。其他標準的符號（如 EN 60601 電氣設備符號、IEC 60417 電氣符號）各自有其適用範圍，不受 ISO 15223-1 的管轄，也不需要滿足本標準的要求。
blocks.en: ISO 15223-1 is not the only medical device symbol standard. Symbols from other standards (such as the EN 60601 electrical equipment symbols and the IEC 60417 electrical symbols) each have their own scope, fall outside the jurisdiction of ISO 15223-1, and do not need to meet the requirements of this standard.

blocks.zh: 實務：一個電氣輸注泵的標籤可能同時包含 ISO 15223-1 符號（如有效期限、製造商）和 EN 60601 電氣安全符號（如 II 類電氣設備），兩個符號系統並存但各自遵守自己的標準。
blocks.en: In practice: the label of an electrical infusion pump may carry both ISO 15223-1 symbols (such as use-by date and manufacturer) and EN 60601 electrical safety symbols (such as Class II equipment). The two symbol systems coexist, each complying with its own standard.

blocks.zh: 一般要求應用練習
blocks.en: Exercises on the general requirements

blocks.zh: 你的客戶要在注射器標籤上使用「在歐洲共同體的授權代理人」符號（5.1.2），但想讓符號的線條更粗一些，使印刷更清晰。這樣可以嗎？
blocks.en: Your client wants to use the "authorized representative in the European Community" symbol (5.1.2) on a syringe label, but wants thicker lines in the symbol so that it prints more clearly. Is this acceptable?

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA 審查員問你：「你們的有效期限符號旁邊為什麼沒有英文 'Use by' 文字？」請引用 ISO 15223-1 第 4.2 條的哪一段來回應？
blocks.en: A US FDA reviewer asks you: "Why is there no English 'Use by' text next to your use-by date symbol?" Which passage of ISO 15223-1 Clause 4.2 would you cite in reply?

blocks.zh: 製造日期在標籤上寫成 "MFG: 03-2026"。這符合 ISO 8601 嗎？應改為什麼格式？
blocks.en: The date of manufacture is written on the label as "MFG: 03-2026". Does this comply with ISO 8601? What format should it be changed to?

blocks.zh: 核心五：日期格式 ISO 8601
blocks.en: Core 5: date format ISO 8601

blocks.zh: 所有與符號搭配的日期必須（shall）使用 ISO 8601：
blocks.en: All dates that accompany symbols must (shall) use ISO 8601:

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤：使用 "04/09/26" 或 "09 APR 2026"，在不同國家可能被解讀為不同日期，違反 ISO 8601。
blocks.en: Common error: using "04/09/26" or "09 APR 2026", which may be read as different dates in different countries and violates ISO 8601.

blocks.zh: Clause 5 & Table 1 — Symbol Category 5.1: Manufacturer Clause 5 & Table 1 — 符號類別 5.1：製造商
blocks.en: Clause 5 & Table 1 — Symbol Category 5.1: Manufacturer

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 符號類別 5.1 製造商組
blocks.en: Commentary — Symbol Category 5.1, the Manufacturer Group

blocks.zh: 5.1.1 製造商符號（Manufacturer）— 最重要的標籤符號
blocks.en: 5.1.1 Manufacturer — the most important label symbol

blocks.zh: 這個工廠圖示是醫療器材標籤上最基本的必要元素。每一個符合 EU MDR 2017/745 和 EU IVDR 2017/746 要求的器材標籤，都必須出現這個符號加上製造商全名和地址。
blocks.en: This factory pictogram is the most basic required element on a medical device label. The label of every device that meets the requirements of EU MDR 2017/745 and EU IVDR 2017/746 must show this symbol together with the manufacturer's full name and address.

blocks.zh: CDMO 重要辨別：標籤上的製造商（Manufacturer）不一定是受託製造商（CMO/CDMO）。EU MDR 第 2(30) 條定義「製造商」為負責設計、製造、包裝和標籤器材，並以自己名義上市的自然人或法人。如果你的客戶（MAH）是 EU MDR 定義下的製造商，則工廠符號旁應填寫客戶的公司名稱和地址，而非你的 CDMO 廠址。
blocks.en: Key CDMO distinction: the manufacturer shown on the label is not necessarily the contract manufacturer (CMO/CDMO). EU MDR Article 2(30) defines the "manufacturer" as the natural or legal person who designs, manufactures, packages and labels a device and places it on the market under their own name. If your client (the MAH) is the manufacturer as defined in the EU MDR, the client's company name and address should be entered next to the factory symbol, not your CDMO site address.

blocks.zh: 比喻：標籤上的角色架構
blocks.en: Analogy: the cast of roles on a label

blocks.zh: 想象一瓶生物製劑的標籤上的四個角色：
blocks.en: Picture the four roles on the label of a biologic product:

blocks.zh: 🏭 製造商（5.1.1）= 你的 CDMO 客戶（MAH，Brand Owner）
blocks.en: 🏭 Manufacturer (5.1.1) = your CDMO's client (the MAH, the brand owner)

blocks.zh: ◯EC EU 授權代理人（5.1.2）= 如果品牌商是美國公司，在歐盟指定的代理人
blocks.en: ◯EC EU authorized representative (5.1.2) = if the brand owner is a US company, the representative it appoints in the EU

blocks.zh: ↔🏭 進口商（5.1.3）= 把產品從美國（製造地）帶進歐盟市場的公司
blocks.en: ↔🏭 Importer (5.1.3) = the company that brings the product from the US (place of manufacture) into the EU market

blocks.zh: 📦 經銷商（5.1.4）= 在歐盟市場內配送到各藥局/醫院的公司
blocks.en: 📦 Distributor (5.1.4) = the company that distributes within the EU market to pharmacies and hospitals

blocks.zh: EU MDR 2017/745 的重要改變：相較於舊 MDD，MDR 明確要求標籤上標示進口商和經銷商的身份，這是 5.1.3 和 5.1.4 符號被廣泛採用的原因。
blocks.en: An important change in EU MDR 2017/745: compared with the old MDD, the MDR expressly requires the identity of the importer and distributor to be shown on the label, which is why the 5.1.3 and 5.1.4 symbols have come into wide use.

blocks.zh: 5.1.2 授權代理人（Authorized Representative）
blocks.en: 5.1.2 Authorized Representative

blocks.zh: EU MDR 第 11 條規定：在歐盟境外設立的製造商，在歐盟市場上市器材前，必須在歐盟境內指定至少一位授權代理人（AR）。AR 需：
blocks.en: EU MDR Article 11 provides that a manufacturer established outside the EU must designate at least one authorized representative (AR) within the EU before placing a device on the EU market. The AR must:

blocks.zh: 在 EUDAMED（歐盟器材資料庫）登錄
blocks.en: be registered in EUDAMED (the European Database on Medical Devices)

blocks.zh: 與製造商建立書面授權協議
blocks.en: enter into a written mandate with the manufacturer

blocks.zh: 對歐盟主管機關負有義務（如不合格品通知、市場上市申報）
blocks.en: have obligations towards EU competent authorities (such as notification of non-conforming products and market placement notifications)

blocks.zh: 標籤要求：AR 的名稱和歐盟境內地址必須清楚標示在標籤上，放在 5.1.2 符號旁邊。
blocks.en: Labelling requirement: the AR's name and EU address must be clearly shown on the label, next to the 5.1.2 symbol.

blocks.zh: 注意：5.1.2 符號沒有 ISO 7000 登錄號碼（N/A），是 ISO 15223-1 專屬定義的符號，不在 ISO 7000 通用圖形庫中。
blocks.en: Note: the 5.1.2 symbol has no ISO 7000 registration number (N/A); it is a symbol defined specifically by ISO 15223-1 and is not in the general ISO 7000 graphics library.

blocks.zh: 進口商與經銷商（5.1.3 & 5.1.4）— EU MDR 新義務
blocks.en: Importer and Distributor (5.1.3 & 5.1.4) — new EU MDR obligations

blocks.zh: EU MDR 2017/745 在供應鏈監管上比舊 MDD 嚴格許多。進口商（Importer）和經銷商（Distributor）現在各有獨立的合規義務：
blocks.en: EU MDR 2017/745 is considerably stricter than the old MDD on supply chain oversight. The importer and the distributor now each have independent compliance obligations:

blocks.zh: 進口商：必須確認器材有 CE 標誌、技術文件完整、製造商已完成 EU MDR 要求。進口商名稱、地址必須標示於標籤或包裝。
blocks.en: Importer: must verify that the device bears the CE mark, that the technical documentation is complete and that the manufacturer has met the EU MDR requirements. The importer's name and address must be shown on the label or packaging.

blocks.zh: 經銷商：必須確認標籤完整、器材在有效期內、儲存條件符合要求。如重新包裝或重新標籤，可能需承擔製造商責任。
blocks.en: Distributor: must verify that the labelling is complete, that the device is within its shelf life and that storage conditions are met. If the distributor repackages or relabels, it may take on the responsibilities of the manufacturer.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的影響：如果你的客戶將生產自你廠的器材出口至歐盟，你的客戶（或其歐盟指定進口商）必須確保 5.1.3 進口商符號及資訊正確標示於包裝上。
blocks.en: Impact on a CDMO: if your client exports devices made at your site to the EU, your client (or its EU-designated importer) must ensure that the 5.1.3 importer symbol and information are correctly shown on the packaging.

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR Part 801 對應比較
blocks.en: Comparison with FDA 21 CFR Part 801

blocks.zh: FDA 對製造商標示的要求（21 CFR 801.1）與 ISO 15223-1 的主要差異：
blocks.en: The main differences between FDA's requirements for manufacturer identification (21 CFR 801.1) and ISO 15223-1:

blocks.zh: FDA 不強制使用 ISO 15223-1 工廠符號，可直接以文字標示 "Manufactured by: [Company Name and Address]"
blocks.en: FDA does not mandate the use of the ISO 15223-1 factory symbol; the manufacturer can simply be identified in text as "Manufactured by: [Company Name and Address]"

blocks.zh: FDA 要求資訊以「英文」呈現，符號需有英文說明
blocks.en: FDA requires the information to be presented in English, and symbols need an English explanation

blocks.zh: FDA 510(k)/PMA 申請中，如使用 ISO 15223-1 符號，需在技術文件中提交符號清單（Symbol Glossary）說明每個符號的含義
blocks.en: If ISO 15223-1 symbols are used in an FDA 510(k)/PMA submission, a symbol list (Symbol Glossary) explaining the meaning of each symbol must be included in the technical documentation

blocks.zh: FDA 2016 年發布「Use of Symbols in Labeling」最終指引，正式認可 ISO 15223-1:2012 符號（2016 版已被廣泛接受）
blocks.en: In 2016 FDA issued the final guidance "Use of Symbols in Labeling", formally recognizing the ISO 15223-1:2012 symbols (the 2016 edition is now widely accepted)

blocks.zh: 符號在 CDMO 充填線上的實際應用場景
blocks.en: Practical application scenarios on a CDMO fill line

blocks.zh: 無菌藥品充填（Aseptic Fill-Finish）：
blocks.en: Aseptic fill-finish:

blocks.zh: 西林瓶標籤：工廠符號（5.1.1）+ 客戶公司名/地址 + 製造日期符號 + YYYY-MM 格式日期
blocks.en: Vial label: factory symbol (5.1.1) + client company name/address + date of manufacture symbol + date in YYYY-MM format

blocks.zh: 外包裝：增加授權代理人符號（5.1.2）（若客戶為非歐盟製造商）
blocks.en: Outer packaging: add the authorized representative symbol (5.1.2) (if the client is a non-EU manufacturer)

blocks.zh: 批次標籤文件：每個符號須對應 ISO 15223-1:2016 Table 1 版本記錄
blocks.en: Batch label documentation: each symbol must correspond to a record of the ISO 15223-1:2016 Table 1 version

blocks.zh: 預充式注射器（PFS）：
blocks.en: Prefilled syringe (PFS):

blocks.zh: 器材本體標籤空間有限，通常只放核心符號（製造商、有效期限、批號、劑量）
blocks.en: Label space on the device body is limited, so usually only the core symbols are shown (manufacturer, use-by date, batch code, dose)

blocks.zh: 詳細的製造商/AR/進口商資訊通常放在外盒/小盒（secondary packaging）
blocks.en: Detailed manufacturer/AR/importer information is usually placed on the carton / secondary packaging

blocks.zh: 符號類別 5.1 綜合練習
blocks.en: Comprehensive exercises on symbol category 5.1

blocks.zh: 一個由美國生技公司（BioTech Inc.）委託台灣 CDMO（TW Pharma）生產的胰島素筆型注射器，在歐盟市場由德國 MedImport GmbH 進口。請列出這個器材標籤上需要的所有 5.1 系列符號，並說明每個符號旁應填寫哪個公司的資訊。
blocks.en: An insulin pen injector is manufactured by a Taiwan CDMO (TW Pharma) on behalf of a US biotech company (BioTech Inc.) and imported into the EU market by MedImport GmbH of Germany. List all the 5.1-series symbols needed on this device's label and state whose information should be entered next to each symbol.

blocks.zh: 客戶提供的標籤草案上，製造日期寫為 "DOM: 2025/11"。根據 ISO 8601 要求，這應該改為什麼格式？
blocks.en: The label draft supplied by the client gives the date of manufacture as "DOM: 2025/11". What should it be changed to under ISO 8601?

blocks.zh: 根據 EU MDR 第 2(30) 條，你的 CDMO 廠在什麼情況下會變成 EU MDR 定義下的「製造商」，需要在標籤上列自己的公司名稱？
blocks.en: Under EU MDR Article 2(30), in what circumstances would your CDMO site become the "manufacturer" as defined in the EU MDR and need to list its own company name on the label?

blocks.zh: 客戶問你：ISO 15223-1 有規定製造商符號（5.1.1）的最小印刷尺寸嗎？請引用標準條文回答。
blocks.en: The client asks you: does ISO 15223-1 specify a minimum print size for the manufacturer symbol (5.1.1)? Answer by citing the text of the standard.

blocks.zh: 一個日本製造商在歐盟市場上市一個 CE 標誌眼科器材，他問你是否需要同時顯示 5.1.1（製造商）和 5.1.2（授權代理人）兩個符號。你如何回答？
blocks.en: A Japanese manufacturer is placing a CE-marked ophthalmic device on the EU market and asks whether it must display both the 5.1.1 (manufacturer) and 5.1.2 (authorized representative) symbols. How do you answer?

blocks.zh: 製造日期 vs. 有效期限：不同符號，不同含義
blocks.en: Date of manufacture vs. use-by date: different symbols, different meanings

blocks.zh: ISO 8601 格式強制要求：製造日期必須使用 YYYY-MM-DD 或 YYYY-MM 或 YYYY 格式，不能用斜線或其他分隔符號。
blocks.en: ISO 8601 format is mandatory: the date of manufacture must use YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY format, and slashes or other separators must not be used.
